lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiAlH4 crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a 24-atom unit cell (Li4Al4H16) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al and Li each adopt tetrahedral coordination by four H atoms, while H is surrounded by two Al and two Li neighbors. The Al- and Li-centered tetrahedra exhibit corner-sharing relations, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites.
